title: Bank-level NOW account survey data (FR 2015), 1974-1980, and Functional Cost Analysis records

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: Bank-level NOW account survey data (FR 2015), 1974-1980, and Functional Cost Analysis records
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

(1) Bank-level (respondent-level) data files from the Board's survey of negotiable order of withdrawal (NOW) accounts, report FR 2015, for all reporting dates from 1974 through 1980, with reporting institution name and identifier, location, rates paid, number of accounts and balances, together with record layouts and instructions. (2) Bank-level records of the Federal Reserve System's Functional Cost Analysis programme for 1965 through 1986 held by the Board, including per-account cost and service-charge income for demand, savings and time deposit functions, or, if bank-level records are not held or not releasable, the most disaggregated tabulations available by bank size class and Federal Reserve district. Electronic copies are preferred. Please treat the two parts separately so that one does not delay the other.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Harsha Dutta

title: Office-level Summary of Deposits data, June 1966 to 1980, and deposit account-size surveys

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: Office-level Summary of Deposits data, June 1966 to 1980, and deposit account-size surveys
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

(1) Office-level (branch-level) data files from the Summary of Deposits survey for each survey date from June 30, 1966 through 1980, with bank name and identifier, office name and number, street address, city, county, state and deposits of each office, together with record layouts. Office-level files for 1981 through 1993 have previously been released to researchers; this request is for the earlier years of the same series. (2) Data files and tabulations from the Corporation's surveys of deposit accounts by size of account for 1964 through 1986, including any cross-classification by rate paid, by bank or by geographic area. Electronic copies are preferred. If some years no longer exist, please release those that do and state which could not be located.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Harsha Dutta

title: Bank-level records of the Survey of Time and Savings Deposits, 1965-1982

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: Bank-level records of the Survey of Time and Savings Deposits, 1965-1982
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Bank-level (respondent-level) data files, tapes or printouts from the Survey of Time and Savings Deposits (also catalogued as FR 2296), conducted by the Board of Governors and, from 1968, jointly with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation. I request all surviving survey waves from December 1965 through the first quarter of 1982, including in particular: (a) the member-bank surveys of December 1965, March 1966 and May 1966; (b) the quarterly waves of 1967 through 1975, and specifically the waves of July 31, 1973 and October 31, 1973 and any special November 1973 wave; (c) the waves of the third quarter of 1976 through the first quarter of 1982. For each wave I request the reporting bank's name and identifier, location, the most common rate paid on each class of time and savings deposit, and the amount outstanding in each class. I also request any tabulations or files that cross-classify deposits by account size and rate paid, by bank or by geographic area, and the record layouts, codebooks and survey instructions for each wave. Electronic copies are preferred. If some waves no longer exist, please release those that do and state which could not be located.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Harsha Dutta
